description: Students investigate the history of Greece from the earliest days to the conquests of Alexander
the Great through questions such as: Who held power in Ancient Greece? How was the position of the
power-holders justified and enforced against the marginalized and disenfranchised? How did the
Greeks construct their past? How do we construct histories of "Greece" today? Key themes are the
Patriarchy, democracy, theatre, philosophy, rhetoric, the writing of history, and architectural
